name: High plank
cue: Set your hands in a diamond below your chest and brace.

name: Lower
cue: Bend your elbows back along your ribs.

name: Stay straight
cue: Lower your chest while keeping shoulders, hips and heels aligned.

name: Bottom
cue: Bring your chest close to your hands without sagging.

name: Press
cue: Press through your hands with elbows tucked.

name: Finish pressing
cue: Continue to straight arms, keeping your core braced.
